subject: russian

storage_design.note: Design only. Do not create or migrate this key in the current trainer before an approved implementation/storage gate.

fields.profile_id: anonymous local learner/profile identifier; no real name required
fields.settings: optional learner UX settings; never source truth for exam rules

fields.exception_id: must resolve to canonical Exceptions Bank
fields.last_mode: practice mode used at last attempt or null
fields.active_error_count: non-negative integer representing unresolved wrong events, not lifetime wrong_count
fields.recent_context_signatures: bounded list used to avoid immediate context repetition

status_semantics.new: known to bank but learner has not produced usable evidence yet
status_semantics.active: learner has started work or has an unresolved error
status_semantics.due: next_due_at is reached and review should be prioritized
status_semantics.stabilizing: learner has recent recall/context success but retention is not yet confirmed
status_semantics.stabilized: retention criterion has been met; history remains and future due checks may still be scheduled

fields.wrong_exception_ids: unique exception IDs wrong at least once in session

update_rules: never mark stabilized after one recognition-only correct answer
wrong answer sets status active and increases wrong_count and active_error_count
exact main-trainer error may create/activate state only when routing identifies a specific exception_id
broad task failure must not create a guessed exception_id state
correct recognition can increment evidence but does not by itself set transfer_passed
transfer_passed requires an independent_context or transfer item under the future mastery policy
retention_passed requires later due evidence, not same-session repetition alone
stabilized status does not delete prior wrong_count/history
schema migration must be explicit and reversible
state update must be idempotent per event_id to prevent double counting after reload/retry
privacy_and_storage_rules: anonymous local use must work without registration
do not store source books or hidden answer banks inside learner state
do not store real name/email unless a future account layer explicitly owns that data
do not silently erase old state when schema version changes
server sync is a future separate layer
